content_zh:
吞元蛙的强，显而易见，好处也相当诱人，有了它，开启体魄轻易而举，到时变强，就能走出村庄，寻找父母。
可无天犯难了，这般厉害的家伙，要怎么降服？
“嗡嗡！”
无天这个想法刚刚生起，阵阵嗡鸣声传出，抬头看去，却见乳色光芒，忽然分裂出无数道，如蝌蚪般，在半空飞舞，不多时，结成一个巴掌大的五角星，散发出隐晦的气息。
五角星光芒闪烁，如同一粒星辰坠落，直奔吞元蛙。
吞元蛙挣扎，狭长的眸子中充满了恐惧，但被光束缠绕，于事无补，五角星瞬间融入它的体内，顿时，其身躯毫光大放，挣扎的动作渐渐停止，仿若生机被抽干般，眸光黯淡，神情萎缩。
做完这一切，乳光如同灯灭般，消融于天地。
同时，无天识海里多了一样东西，那是一种感觉，仿佛掌控了吞元蛙的生死，只需念头一动，便会立刻死亡，这感觉很奇妙，却真实存在。
“呱呱！”
念头微动，吞元蛙立刻疯狂挣扎，惊惧大叫，身躯如同痉挛般，抽搐不止，两只如珍珠的眸子，逐渐放大，口中唾液直流，这是身死的征兆。
无天一惊，急忙散去念头，吞元蛙立刻停止挣扎，颇为心悸的瞄了眼无天，双目中不但没有凶光怒气，反而充满恭维，蹦其头顶，似讨好般，长舌卷动，拨弄黑发。
“降服了？”
无天呆愣片刻，欣喜若狂，同时心中疑惑，这乳光究竟是什么东西，为何会从额头出现，十六年可从没出现过，再度抚摸额头，然而并无异样。
“呱！”这时，吞元蛙从他头顶跃下，落于一块碎石上，鸣叫了一声，身躯当下泛起光芒，大嘴张开，一枚黄豆大，血色的丹丸浮现。
瞧见这奇异的一幕，无天散去脑袋的疑惑，道：“你打算给我？”
“呱呱！”吞元蛙点头，双眸宝石般光洁，甚是灵动。
伸手接过血丸，无天顿时感觉到，一股精纯的精元，从掌心窜进手臂，流淌至全身，驱走寒冷，心生暖意。
“精元……”
这枚血丸，原来这是吞元蛙之前吞食了噬血虫，并将其血气与精气提炼而出，凝聚成的精元。这东西可相当珍贵，精纯而浓厚，包含噬血虫所有的精华，若是炼化，不说能立刻开启体魄，最少能够强健身躯，打下根基。
无天也不矫情，道谢了声，直接放入怀中。

修炼一途，迎朝阳，纳朝气，效果倍加，无天收起精元，准备清晨朝阳初升，再行炼化。
俯下身，无天托起吞元蛙，入手冰冰凉凉，且带着粘稠的感觉，定眼一看，原来其身躯上，布满了黑色的液体，有些恶心。
“越看越像魔蛙。”无天笑道：“小东西，你以后跟着我，那我给你起个名字，恩，就叫小魔蛙怎么样？”
吞元蛙呱呱直叫，狭长的眸中，有着浓浓的不屑，仿佛是无天将它与魔蛙相提并论，而不满。
“那叫小黑？”
“呱呱！”
“看你老是呱呱叫，不然叫傻瓜？”
“呱呱！”
“哈哈，好了，不逗你了，我叫无天，以后你的名字，就叫小天吧。”
“嗖”的一下，吞元蛙跳到无天头上，使劲拨弄其头发，显然对这个名字很满意，而无天头上，片刻间便湿漉漉，黏稠稠。
无天也不在意，正欲离开，目光却忽然锁定在那早已化为白骨的黑豹身上，那里有一道微弱的亮光，一闪而逝，被他捕捉到。
掀起尸体，一枚巴掌大，黑漆漆的令牌出现，表面并未纹络，光滑如镜，无天走了过去，疑惑的拾起，却在入手之际，一股冰冷的气流，陡然袭来。
这气流很冷，犹如万年寒冰般，冻人灵魂，无天的身躯，瞬间布满了寒霜，且正在快速凝结出冰块，他心中大骇，想要丢弃，但手掌完全僵硬，无法动弹。
“呱呱！”这时，吞元蛙一跃而下，大嘴一张，咬在无天的手臂上，几缕血液溢出。
无天顿时感觉，体内的气流正迅速流失，暖意渐生，身躯稍微能动，便急忙丢掉令牌，那冰冷的气流方才逐渐消失。
时至片刻，吞元蛙才将他体内的寒气全部吸收，无天活动了筋骨，余悸的看着地上的令牌，刚才若非吞元蛙相救，吸走体内寒气，现在怕是已被活活冻死，成为冰雕。

content_en:
The strength of the Yuan-Swallowing Frog is obvious, and the benefits are quite attractive. With it, it is easy to unlock the body. When it becomes stronger, it can leave the village and find its parents.
But Wutian is in trouble. How can he surrender to such a powerful guy?
"Buzz!"
As soon as Wu Tian had this idea, there were buzzing sounds. When he looked up, he saw milky light suddenly split into countless rays, flying in the air like tadpoles. After a while, they formed into a palm-sized five-pointed star, emitting a mysterious aura.
The five-pointed star flashed like a star falling, heading straight for the Yuan-Swallowing Frog.
The Yuan-Swallowing Frog struggled, its narrow eyes full of fear, but it was entangled by the beam, which did not help. The five-pointed star instantly merged into its body. Suddenly, its body shone brightly, and its struggling movements gradually stopped. As if its life had been drained, its eyes dimmed and its expression shrank.
After doing all this, the opalescent light melted into the heaven and earth like a lamp extinguished.
At the same time, there is something more in the Wutian Sea of ​​​​Consciousness. It is a feeling, as if it controls the life and death of the yuan-swallowing frog. Just a thought, it will die immediately. This feeling is strange, but it is real.
"Quack!"
With the slightest thought, the Yuan-Swallowing Frog immediately struggled wildly and screamed in fear. His body was twitching like a convulsion. His two pearl-like eyes gradually enlarged and saliva flowed from his mouth. This was a sign of death.
Wutian was startled and hurriedly dismissed his thoughts. The Yuan-Swallowing Frog immediately stopped struggling and glanced at Wutian with a rather palpitating look. Instead of being fierce and angry, his eyes were full of compliments. He jumped on his head as if to please, and rolled his long tongue and played with his black hair.
"Surrendered?"
Wutian was stunned for a moment, ecstatic, and at the same time he was wondering what the opalescence was and why it appeared from his forehead. It had never appeared in sixteen years. He touched his forehead again, but there was nothing strange.
"Quack!" At this time, the Yuan-Swallowing Frog jumped down from above his head, landed on a piece of gravel, and screamed. Its body immediately glowed with light, its mouth opened, and a blood-colored pill as big as a soybean appeared.
Seeing this strange scene, Wutian dismissed the doubts in his head and said, "Are you going to give it to me?"
"Quack!" The Yuan-Swallowing Frog nodded, his eyes as bright as gems and very smart.
Reaching out to take the blood pill, Wutian immediately felt a stream of pure essence flowing from his palm into his arm and flowing to his whole body, driving away the cold and feeling warm in his heart.
"Jingyuan..."
This blood pill turned out to be the essence that the Yuan-Swallowing Frog had swallowed before, and the blood and essence were refined and condensed into essence. This thing is quite precious, pure and thick, containing all the essence of blood-devouring insects. If it is refined, it can not only open up the body immediately, but at least strengthen the body and lay a foundation.
Wutian didn't show any pretense, he thanked him and put it directly into his arms.
Along the way of cultivation, he welcomes the morning sun and absorbs the vitality, and the effect is doubled. Wutian puts away the essence and prepares for refining when the morning sun rises.
Leaning down, Wutian held up the Yuan-Swallowing Frog. His hands were cold and had a sticky feeling. After a closer look, it turned out that its body was covered with black liquid, which was a bit disgusting.
"The more you look at it, the more you look like a devil frog." Wutian smiled and said, "Little one, if you follow me from now on, then I will give you a name. Well, how about you call me little devil frog?"
The Yuan-Swallowing Frog croaked, and there was deep disdain in its narrow eyes, as if Wutian was dissatisfied with comparing it to the Demon Frog.
"Is that called Xiao Hei?"
"Quack!"
"Look at you always croaking, otherwise you would be called a fool?"
"Quack!"
"Haha, okay, I won't tease you anymore. My name is Wutian. From now on, your name will be Xiaotian."
With a "swish" sound, the swallowing yuan frog jumped on Wutian's head and ruffled his hair vigorously. He was obviously very satisfied with the name, but Wutian's head became wet and sticky in a moment.
Wutian didn't care, and was about to leave, but his eyes suddenly locked on the black panther that had turned into bones. There was a faint light there, a flash of light.And passed away, captured by him.
Lifting the corpse, a palm-sized, pitch-black token appeared. There were no lines on the surface, and it was as smooth as a mirror. Wutian walked over and picked it up doubtfully, but when he picked it up, a cold air flow suddenly hit him.
This air flow was very cold, like thousands of years of ice, freezing one's soul. Wutian's body was instantly covered with frost, and ice cubes were rapidly condensing. He was horrified and wanted to throw it away, but his palms were completely stiff and unable to move.
"Quack!" At this time, the yuan-swallowing frog jumped down, opened its big mouth, and bit Wutian's arm, and a few strands of blood spilled out.
Wutian suddenly felt that the airflow in his body was rapidly disappearing, and warmth was gradually growing. He hurriedly threw away the token when his body could move a little, and the cold airflow gradually disappeared.
It took a moment for the Yuan-Swallowing Frog to absorb all the cold air in his body. Wutian moved his muscles and bones and looked at the token on the ground with fear. If the Yuan-Swallowing Frog hadn't come to his rescue just now and absorbed the cold air from his body, he would have been frozen to death and turned into an ice sculpture.
